<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> was introduced in [[Game of Crone]] DLC. It is rewarded upon completing the revolution quest line with [[Donkey]].

The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} equips to the {{Icon|pickaxe}} slot and is used when [[mining]].

Efficiency represents how much progress toward an operation each swing of the axe provides.  A 100% efficiency would cause something to progress at the normal rate while 200% would mean it progressed at twice that rate.  The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} has an efficiency of 200%.

Energy usage represents how much energy each operation consumes. The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} requires only {{Energy|-|1}} per swing.

The Ice axe is also the only pickax that is indestructible, making all other pickaxes redundant.

==Trivia==
The Ice axe and its flavour text are a reference to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leon_Trotsky Leon Trotsky], who was notoriously assassinated with an ice axe as a traitor to the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soviet_Union Soviet Union].
